competition.title: Chess
competition.details:
All that you need to know about Chess - techFEST'26

For Non-SLIET Participants Only

techFEST'26 is North India's premier technical festival, organised by Sant Longowal Institute of Engineering and Technology (SLIET), Longowal, Punjab. "This is a free opportunity for all participants."

For Queries and Updates:

  • Naman Kumar Sinha (Overall Coordinator): +91 78568 93952
  • Shubham Kumar Singh (Overall Coordinator): +91 97711 74465
  • Email: techfest@sliet.ac.in
  • Website: www.techfest26.com
  • Follow us on Instagram and other social media platforms for updates.

 

Note: For accommodation and other perks visit the website and it's mendetry for registration.

 

Register Now:

www.techfest26.com

About the Event:

We cordially invite you to Chess, organised as part of techFEST'26 - Annual Technical Festival of SLIET. Showcase your talent, compete with the sharpest minds and earn your moment of glory.

Online Team Competition for Chess Enthusiasts

About the Opportunity:

Dive into the strategic world of Chess with an exciting online competition hosted by the Sant Longowal Institute of Engineering and Technology, Longowal, Punjab. This event is designed for passionate players looking to test their skills and strategic thinking in a dynamic, team-based format.

Engage in thrilling matches from the comfort of your own space, collaborating with teammates to outmaneuver opponents. This online competition offers a unique platform to showcase your chess prowess and enjoy the intellectual challenge of the game.

Number of Rounds: 3

Round 1: Open Qualifiers

Round 2: Clash Squad Semis

Round 3: Grand Finals

Point Table:

  • Win: 1 point
  • Draw: 0.5 points
  • Loss: 0 points

Event Rules:

  • The event will be conducted as an individual competition.
  • Rounds will be Qualifiers, Semi Finals, and Finals.
  • All participants must carry a valid college ID card and their techFEST'26 registration receipt.
  • Reporting time will be communicated to registered teams; late reporting may lead to a walkover.
  • The decision of the judges and organisers will be final and binding in all matters.
  • Any form of misconduct, plagiarism or use of unfair means leads to immediate disqualification.
  • Participants are responsible for their own equipment and personal belongings.
  • Organisers reserve the right to modify any rule at any time; updates are announced at the venue.

Website: www.techfest26.com
Email: techfest@sliet.ac.in

Eligibility:

  • Open to students of all institutes and all degree programmes, unless specified otherwise in the event rules above.
  • Participants must be registered for techFEST'26 through the official portal.
  • Cross-college teams are welcome.

Prizes:

Prizes worth Rs 40,000+ for this event.

  • 1st place: Winner trophy/certificate and cash prize
  • 2nd place: Runner-up certificate and cash prize
  • Certificates of participation for all registered participants.

Why You Should Participate:

Chess is more than a competition - it is a platform to test your skills against the brightest minds from institutes across the region, learn from judges and mentors, and build memories that last far beyond the festival. Winners take home cash prizes, trophies and certificates that strengthen their resumes, while every participant leaves with experience, exposure and connections. Whether you are a seasoned competitor or a first-timer, the arena at techFEST'26 welcomes you.

About the Festival - techFEST'26 at SLIET:

techFEST'26 is the annual technical festival of Sant Longowal Institute of Engineering and Technology (SLIET), Longowal, Punjab - a deemed-to-be university under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. Established in 1989, accredited with Grade A by NAAC, SLIET spreads across a lush 451-acre campus with 11 departments and more than 5,000 students.

With a legacy of over 28 years, techFEST'26 - themed 'Technology and Sciences for Sustainable Earth' - features 50+ events across 11 clubs and a total prize pool of Rs 5,00,000+, along with workshops, exhibitions, guest lectures and a grand cultural evening.

Festival Highlights at techFEST'26:

  • 50+ technical, non-technical and cultural events across 11 clubs
  • Total prize pool worth Rs 5,00,000+
  • Grand cultural evening and pro-shows
  • Hands-on workshops, exhibitions and expert guest lectures
  • Early-bird registration packages for participants from all institutes

Accommodation and Meals:

Participants opting for the Rs 599 package receive hostel accommodation on campus for the duration of the festival. Accommodation is allotted on a first-come, first-served basis, and meal charges are applicable as per institute norms (approximately Rs 50 per diet). All participants must carry their registration receipts and a valid college ID card at all times while on campus.

Code of Conduct:

  • Maintain discipline and decorum across the campus and all event venues.
  • Indiscipline or misbehaviour with volunteers, organisers or fellow participants leads to disqualification.
  • Consumption of alcohol, tobacco or any intoxicants is strictly prohibited on campus.
  • Participants must not damage institute property; recovery costs may be charged.
  • Organisers reserve the right to remove any participant violating the code of conduct.

Refund and Cancellation Policy:

The registration fee, once paid, is non-refundable under any circumstances. In case an event is cancelled by the organisers, registered participants will be accommodated in an alternative event where feasible.

How to Prepare:

Read the event rules above carefully and prepare accordingly. Carry your own stationery, chargers and any personal equipment mentioned in the rules. Reach the venue at least 30 minutes before your reporting time, and follow the official techFEST'26 social media handles for last-minute updates and announcements.

How to Reach SLIET:

Sant Longowal Institute of Engineering and Technology is located at Longowal, District Sangrur, Punjab - well connected by road and rail. The nearest railway stations are Dhuri and Sangrur; the institute is a short taxi/bus ride from either. Ample parking and signboards guide visitors to the festival venues inside the campus.

Frequently Asked Questions:

Q. Who can participate in techFEST'26 events?

A. Students of any institute and any degree programme can participate, provided they register through the official portal.

Q. Is accommodation available for outstation participants?

A. Yes - choose the Rs 599 package for on-campus hostel accommodation during the festival.

Q. Can students from different colleges form one team?

A. Yes, cross-college teams are welcome in team events.

Q. Will participation certificates be provided?

A. Yes, every registered participant receives a participation certificate; winners receive trophies, cash prizes and certificates of merit.

Q. What if an event's timing clashes with another event I registered for?

A. Inform the event organisers at the help desk; schedules are adjusted wherever possible.

Q. Whom should I contact for queries?

A. Reach out to the overall coordinators listed below or write to techfest@sliet.ac.in.

Q. Do I need to bring my own equipment?

A. Only where the event rules above specify; everything else is provided by the organisers.

Q. Can I participate in multiple events during the festival?

A. Yes - your single techFEST'26 registration covers participation across all events, subject to event schedules.

Indicative Event Day Schedule:

  • Reporting and verification: 30–45 minutes before the scheduled start
  • Participants' briefing and rules walkthrough by the event head
  • Competition rounds as described above, with short breaks between rounds
  • Results announcement and prize distribution at the venue, shortly after judging

Exact timings for each event are shared with registered participants over email/SMS and at the help desk. Keep an eye on the official social media handles for the final schedule.

Awards and Recognition:

Winners and runners-up receive trophies and cash prizes as per the prize details above, along with certificates of merit. All participants receive e-certificates of participation. Outstanding performers may also get the opportunity to be featured on the official techFEST'26 social media handles and be considered for future flagship events at SLIET.

Safety and Fair Play Policy:

techFEST'26 is committed to a safe, inclusive and fair competition environment. Every event is supervised by faculty coordinators and trained student volunteers. First-aid support is available on campus throughout the festival. Any participant found violating safety instructions, tampering with equipment, or engaging in unfair practices will be disqualified and escorted out of the venue. Report any concern to the event head or the help desk immediately - your safety comes first.

Terms and Conditions:

  • Participation in techFEST'26 events implies acceptance of all the rules mentioned above.
  • The organisers hold the right to use photographs and videos of the event for promotional purposes.
  • Prize money is distributed after the completion of the festival, post verification of winners.
  • In case of any dispute, the decision of the festival convenor shall be final and binding.
  • All disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of courts at Sangrur, Punjab.
  • All payments must be made exclusively through our official TechFest website. Kindly complete your payment through: https://app.techfest26.com/package

Accommodation and Meals:

Registration for the techFEST’26 package is compulsory for accommodation and other perks, while participation in individual events is free*.

Contact Information:

  • Domain Coordinator: Apurv Raj (254073145/GME), +91 7488233310
  • Event Coordinator: Krish Rajan (254033105/GCS), +91 9263599549

Prepare yourself for a journey of technology, creativity and celebration.

Mark your calendars and be part of the magic of techFEST'26 at SLIET!
